content: What do you want from me this time?
I need to know why you've been showing up at my workplace. This has to stop.
If it stops, I'll stop sending those pictures to everyone you know. Your little secret won't stay buried much longer.
You don't have to do this. We can find a way to fix whatever this is without ruining both our lives.
Fix it? The only way you fix this is by doing exactly what I say. One wrong move, and I make sure you're finished.
Please, just tell me what you want. I'm willing to work something out.
I want you to keep quiet and disappear from the places you're not supposed to be. If you go to the cops, I swear you'll regret it.
Threatening me won't solve anything. We can handle this without more damage.
You don't get to decide that. Remember, I hold all the cards ,  and I'm not afraid to play them.
